county.description: Case-insensitive substring match on county, e.g. NORFOLK, GREATER LONDON.
county.title: County contains

district.description: Case-insensitive substring match on local authority district, e.g. SOUTH NORFOLK.
district.title: District contains

limit.description: Maximum transaction rows pushed to the dataset. Leave empty to return all matching rows. Note: an unfiltered run returns the whole archive (tens of millions of rows).
limit.title: Max rows returned

mode.description: rows = matching transaction rows to the dataset; analytics = derived analytics to the key-value store (record ANALYTICS); both = both.
mode.title: Mode

monthFrom.description: Earliest transfer month to include, YYYY-MM, e.g. 2020-01. Archive starts 1995-01. Also selects which year partitions are read.
monthFrom.title: Month from

monthTo.description: Latest transfer month to include, YYYY-MM, e.g. 2026-09.
monthTo.title: Month to

oldNew.description: Y = new build, N = established dwelling. Leave empty for both.
oldNew.title: Old / new (Y or N)

postcodeArea.description: Exact postcode area match, e.g. NR, SW, L. Case-insensitive.
postcodeArea.title: Postcode area

postcodeDistrict.description: Exact postcode district (outward code) match, e.g. NR9, SW1A. Case-insensitive.
postcodeDistrict.title: Postcode district

postcodeSector.description: Exact postcode sector match, e.g. NR9 5. Case-insensitive.
postcodeSector.title: Postcode sector

ppdCategory.description: A = Standard Price Paid entries, B = Additional Price Paid entries. Leave empty for both. HMLR excludes Category B from its own headline price statistics.
ppdCategory.title: PPD category (A or B)

propertyType.description: Property type: code D (Detached), S (Semi-detached), T (Terraced), F (Flats/Maisonettes), O (Other), or the exact label, e.g. 'Detached'. Case-insensitive.
propertyType.title: Property type

tenure.description: Tenure: code F (Freehold) or L (Leasehold), or the exact label. Case-insensitive. (The source field is named 'duration'.)
tenure.title: Tenure (F or L)

townCity.description: Case-insensitive substring match on town/city, e.g. NORWICH.
townCity.title: Town / city contains
